key_points: Kernel: The core of the operating system that manages CPU, memory, devices and system ca
Distribution: A complete OS package: kernel plus installer, desktop, tools and software reposi
Bootloader: The small program that loads the operating system kernel when the machine powers
Package manager: The tool that installs, updates and removes software from trusted repositories.
Desktop environment: The graphical shell: windows, panels, menus, file manager and settings.
File system: The scheme organizing data on disk, such as ext4, NTFS, APFS or Btrfs.
Driver: Software that lets the OS talk to a hardware device such as a printer or graphic
Shell: The command-line interpreter where typed commands run programs and scripts.
LTS: Long-term support release: years of security updates instead of months.
Virtual memory: The OS technique that extends RAM with disk space so programs get the memory the
